d.ko:
★ Surreal dice-rolling roguelike about luck and greed ★
Feed your dice dumplings, collect game bending trinkets, roll too much and lose it all.
Or get lucky, unlock King Fetus, meet God and you might just wake up.

d.zh:
★ 一款关于运气与贪欲的超现实掷骰子肉鸽 ★
给骰子喂饺子，收集能颠覆规则的玩意儿，贪心多扔几次，然后输个精光。
或者走个大运，解锁胎儿王，见到神，说不定你就能醒过来。
